# Houzz

> Houzz is a location-based professional directory platform connecting homeowners with vetted contractors, architects, designers, and home improvement specialists for renovation and construction projects.

Houzz maintains comprehensive local professional directories across major cities, enabling homeowners to find and hire qualified specialists for kitchen remodeling, bathroom renovation, home construction, interior design, and other home improvement needs. The platform serves as a contractor matching service with location-based search capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Professional Directory
- Location-Based Search
- Home Remodeling
- Kitchen Remodeling
- Bathroom Remodeling
- General Contractors
- Interior Designers
- Architects
- Home Builders
- Contractor Matching
- Home Renovation
- Custom Homes
- Design-Build Firms
- Local Professionals
- Home Improvement
